story.missionBrief:
=== MISSION BRIEFING ===
Role: Crystalline Defense Specialist
Type: DEFENSE

Objective: Protect 3 crystal matrices from 7 waves of malware corruption
Location: Sacred geometric chamber, Crystal Vault 9
Threat: Malware swarms attacking in coordinated waves
Method: Position defensive crystals to create protective barriers
Time Constraint: 120 seconds to withstand all attack waves

=== AVAILABLE ABILITIES ===
• Crystal Barrier: Deploy protective shield around one matrix (15 seconds cooldown)
• Purge Pulse: Clear malware from small area (8 seconds cooldown)
• Sacred Lock: Make one matrix invulnerable for 10 seconds [2 charges]

=== STAKES ===
Success: Matrices protected, sacred geometry preserved
Failure: Matrices corrupted, geometric power lost
